mapper.select: SELECT da.id,da.ingest_record_id record_id,r.event_time,da.contract_version,da.alert_type,da.alert_layer,da.score FROM ingest_record r JOIN detection_alert da ON da.ingest_record_id=r.id WHERE r.asset_id=#{asset} AND r.event_time >= #{from} AND r.event_time <= #{to} AND (da.alert_type='rule' OR (da.severity_policy_version=#{severityVersion} AND da.correlation_policy_version=#{correlationVersion})) ORDER BY r.event_time,da.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE detection_alert SET alert_layer='alert',severity=#{severity},promoted_at=#{now}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),basis_json=JSON_SET(basis_json,'$.promotion',CAST(#{basis} AS JSON)) WHERE id=#{id} AND alert_layer='signal' AND alert_type='model'
